title: Awesome Presentation Tools
subtitle: A comprehensive and curated list of the best presentation tools as of November 2025, organized by category and use case.

aiPowered.title: AI-Powered
aiPowered.description: AI-powered tools that generate presentations from prompts, content, or simple text descriptions.

tools.runable: AI-powered platform for generating presentations, websites, and more. Full-stack solution for designers and developers.
tools.gamma: A new medium for presenting ideas, powered by AI. Create presentations, websites, and documents in seconds without coding or design skills.
tools.tome: AI-powered storytelling format with beautiful, dynamic layouts. Perfect for narrative-driven presentations.
tools.beautifulai: Generative AI presentation software for teams. Smart Slides automatically adjust layouts and apply brand guidelines.
tools.decktopus: AI presentation generator with auto-adjusted layouts. Create professional decks in minutes with voice recording and forms.
tools.slidesai: AI-powered Google Slides add-on. Generate presentation slides from any text in seconds. Supports 100+ languages.
tools.genppt: Create complete slide decks instantly from text prompts. Generates up to 10 slides at a time with chat-based editing.
tools.slidesgo: Free AI presentation maker. Convert topics into stunning presentations with 100+ professional templates.
tools.presentationsai: Create PPTs, infographics, charts, timelines, project plans, and product roadmaps with AI.
tools.plusai: AI add-in for PowerPoint and Google Slides. Works within your existing tools for seamless AI-assisted editing.
tools.simplified: All-in-one AI content creation platform with presentation maker. Includes design, video, and copywriting tools.
tools.designsai: AI-powered creative suite with presentation maker, logo creator, and video editor.
tools.slideoo: AI presentation maker that transforms documents and ideas into slides. Real-time collaboration and export to multiple formats.
tools.popai: AI assistant for creating presentations with smart content suggestions and visual enhancements.
tools.kromaai: AI-powered presentation tool focused on sales and marketing decks. Automatic design suggestions and content optimization.

aiEnterprise.title: AI-Powered (Enterprise & Advanced)
aiEnterprise.description: Professional-grade AI tools for large teams with compliance, security, and customization requirements.

tools.prezent: Enterprise AI presentation software with contextual intelligence. Features 100% brand compliance and 35,000+ templates.
tools.storydoc: AI-powered interactive presentations for sales, marketing, and investor pitches. Real-time analytics and engagement tracking.
tools.preziai: Visual storytelling software with AI enhancements. Non-linear, conversational presentations with dynamic zoom features.
tools.curipod: AI-powered interactive presentations designed for educators and trainers. Features real-time engagement tools.

webBased.title: Web-Based & Collaborative
webBased.description: Cloud-based tools with real-time collaboration, easy sharing, and cross-platform access.

tools.pitch: Collaborative presentation software for modern teams. Real-time editing, commenting, and version control with Slack integration.
tools.canva: Free design tool with thousands of presentation templates. Magic Design AI for auto-generated layouts. 2M+ assets.
tools.googleslides: Free online presentations with seamless real-time collaboration. Integrates with Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets.
tools.visme: Drag-and-drop editor with 15,000+ templates, animations, and data visualizations. Brand Wizard for consistent branding.
tools.slidebean: AI-assisted presentation tool for pitch decks. Combines professional templates with collaborative editing.
tools.powerpoint: Cloud-based PowerPoint with real-time collaboration, Designer AI, and Copilot integration.
tools.zohoshow: Online presentation software with real-time collaboration. Part of Zoho's productivity suite.
tools.slides: Web-based presentation editor built on Reveal.js. Combines code flexibility with visual editing interface.
tools.slidesfly: Publish existing HTML, Reveal.js, Slidev, or Marp decks from a CLI or Agent Skill to stable share URLs.
tools.swipe: Mobile-first presentation platform. Create and present from any device with touch-optimized controls.
tools.emaze: Cloud-based presentation software with 3D templates and automatic design. Video presentations and analytics included.
tools.genially: Create interactive presentations, infographics, and gamified content. Rich animation and interactivity options.

developer.title: Developer & Markdown-Based
developer.description: Perfect for developers who prefer writing code and using version control. These tools integrate with Git/GitHub workflows.

tools.slidev: Presentation slides for developers. Write in Markdown, Vue, and HTML. Built with Vue.js and Vite. MIT licensed.
tools.revealjs: The HTML Presentation Framework. Create interactive, web-based presentations with HTML/CSS/JS. Supports nested slides and plugins.
tools.marp: Markdown Presentation Ecosystem. Convert Markdown into HTML, PDF, and PowerPoint. VS Code extension available.
tools.remarkjs: Create Markdown presentations on Linux and other platforms. Simple, powerful, and highly customizable with plugins.
tools.mdxdeck: React + Markdown presentation framework. Build presentations using MDX syntax with full React component support.
tools.spectacle: React-based presentation library. Build presentations with JSX and React components.
tools.fusuma: Markdown-based presentation tool with live reload. Supports WebSlides and PDF export.
tools.deckset: Mac & iOS app. Write presentations in Markdown with beautiful themes. Perfect for Apple ecosystem users.
tools.cleaver: 30-second slideshows for hackers. Generate presentations from Markdown files with simple YAML configuration.
tools.hackerslides: Presentation tool for developers. Write in Markdown, present from browser, and store in GitHub.
tools.pandoc: Universal document converter. Convert Markdown to many presentation formats (reveal.js, PowerPoint, Beamer, etc.).
tools.backslide: CLI tool for creating HTML5 presentations from Markdown. Lightweight and developer-friendly.
tools.slido: Q&A and polling platform that integrates with presentations. Perfect for developer conferences and tech talks.

visual.title: Visual & Interactive
visual.description: Tools emphasizing creativity, visual appeal, and interactive audience engagement.

tools.prezi: Non-linear, visual storytelling software with zoom-based navigation. Cinematic and engaging presentation style.
tools.ludus: Limitless creativity for slides. Advanced visual editing with animations, custom layouts, and interactive elements.
tools.haikudeck: Beautiful, visual presentations with professionally designed templates. AI image search integration.
tools.powtoon: Video-based presentation creator. Combine slides, animations, and video clips for dynamic content.
tools.vyond: Animated video presentation maker. Create professional animated presentations with customizable characters and scenes.
tools.animaker: DIY video animation software. Create animated presentations with drag-and-drop interface and 1000+ templates.
tools.vevox: Interactive presentation platform with real-time audience engagement tools, polling, and Q&A.
tools.peardeck: Interactive presentation tool for classroom and training settings. Real-time student responses and engagement.
tools.mentimeter: Polling and interactive presentation tool. Engage audiences with real-time Q&A, polls, and quizzes.
tools.kahoot: Gamified quiz and interactive presentation platform. Perfect for educational and training presentations.
tools.nearpod: Interactive lesson and presentation platform. Includes VR field trips, 3D objects, and gamification.
tools.ahaslides: Interactive presentation software with live polls, quizzes, and word clouds. Great for hybrid events.
tools.polleverywhere: Live polling and Q&A for presentations. Real-time audience response system with SMS and web voting.
tools.wooclap: Interactive presentation platform with 18+ question types. Real-time feedback and engagement analytics.

dataViz.title: Data Visualization & Analytics
dataViz.description: Specialized tools for data-driven presentations, charts, and business intelligence.

tools.thinkcell: Add-in for PowerPoint. Automated creation of advanced charts (Gantt, waterfall, Mekko). Real-time Excel integration.
tools.infogram: Create interactive infographics, charts, and visualizations. Rich data visualization library and real-time collaboration.
tools.datawrapper: Easy chart and map creation. Perfect for data journalists and analysts. Publish embeddable visualizations.
tools.flourish: Beautiful data visualizations and interactive charts. No coding required. Templates for storytelling with data.
tools.tableaupublic: Free data visualization platform. Create interactive dashboards and embed them in presentations.
tools.powerbi: Microsoft's business analytics service. Create interactive reports and dashboards for data-driven presentations.
tools.lookerstudio: Google's free data visualization tool. Turn data into informative dashboards and reports.
tools.chartblocks: Simple chart creation tool. Integrates data from multiple sources for real-time updating charts.
tools.rawgraphs: Open-source data visualization framework. Create custom vector-based visualizations from spreadsheets.
tools.plotly: Interactive graphing library. Create publication-quality graphs and dashboards with Python, R, or JavaScript.

tools.keynote: Apple's premium presentation software. Exclusive to macOS/iOS. Elegant design and powerful animation capabilities.
tools.libreoffice: Open-source presentation software (free alternative to PowerPoint). Supports multiple formats.
tools.openoffice: Another free, open-source presentation tool with broad format support.
tools.beamer: LaTeX document class for creating presentations. Perfect for academic and scientific presentations with complex formulas.
tools.pitchdeck: Specialized tool for startup pitch decks. Templates and guidance from successful fundraising decks.
tools.slidedog: Multimedia presentation tool. Combine PowerPoint, PDFs, videos, and web pages in one seamless presentation.
tools.mmhmm: Virtual camera app for video presentations. Add slides, effects, and dynamic layouts to video calls.
tools.obsidian: Note-taking app with markdown-based presentation plugin support. Great for knowledge-driven presentations.
tools.notion: All-in-one workspace with presentation capabilities. Create slide decks from your notes and databases.
tools.coda: Doc-based presentation tool. Combine documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in one platform.
tools.omnigraffle: Diagramming tool that can be extended for presentation creation. Excellent for technical presentations.
tools.miro: Online collaborative whiteboard with presentation mode. Perfect for workshops and brainstorming sessions.
tools.figjam: Figma's whiteboard tool with presentation capabilities. Great for design teams and collaborative sessions.

tools.googleslidesmobile: Full Google Slides functionality on mobile devices. Offline editing support.
tools.powerpointmobile: Mobile PowerPoint with Copilot and collaboration features.
tools.canvamobile: Canva's mobile app for on-the-go presentation creation and editing.
tools.keynoteios: Full-featured Keynote for iPhone and iPad with Apple Pencil support.

tools.impressjs: Presentation framework built on modern web technologies. HTML/CSS/JavaScript based.
tools.shower: Simple HTML presentation engine. Lightweight and easy to customize.
tools.gitpitch: Create presentations from Markdown in Git repositories. Version control for presentations.
tools.pptxjs: JavaScript library for rendering PowerPoint files in browsers. No server-side dependencies.
tools.big: Presentations for busy messy hackers. Simple HTML-based slides with minimal configuration.
tools.bespokejs: DIY presentation micro-framework. Build custom presentation experiences with plugins.
tools.webslides: Create beautiful HTML presentations. 120+ slides ready to use with minimal markup.
tools.sent: Minimalist presentation tool for X11. Lightweight and Unix-philosophy inspired.
tools.landslide: Generate HTML5 slideshows from Markdown, ReST, or Textile. Python-based with themes.
tools.hovercraft: Create impress.js presentations from reStructuredText. Python-based with 3D effects.
tools.patat: Terminal-based presentation tool. Present Markdown slides directly in your terminal.

plugins.title: Plugins & Extensions
plugins.description: Enhance existing tools with additional functionality.

tools.copilotpro: AI assistance directly in PowerPoint. Design suggestions and content generation.
tools.gemini: AI-powered content suggestions and design assistance in Google Slides.
tools.marpvscode: Edit Marp presentations directly in VS Code with live preview.
tools.revealjsplugins: Extensive plugin ecosystem for Reveal.js presentations.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.text: Contributions welcome! Read the contribution guidelines first.
